summary: safeGit now returns a GitResult object with code, stdout and stderr instead of a stdout string. A failing git command now returns a result instead of throwing. The change also exports the GitResult type from the core package.

findings.title: safeGit return shape and error contract changed without updating callers
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object and no longer throws on failure. The callers currentBranch in packages/cli/src/branch.ts and changedFiles in packages/cli/src/status.ts still treat the result as a string.
findings.consequence: In currentBranch, name.trim() throws a TypeError that its catch swallows, so it always returns null. The CLI main then always prints not a git repository and exits 1.
findings.fix: Update currentBranch to check result.code and trim result.stdout. Update changedFiles to split result.stdout and handle a nonzero code.

findings.title: New safeGit failure path has no covering test
findings.problem: safeGit gained a catch branch that maps a failed git command to a GitResult. The repository has no test files that exercise this branch.
findings.consequence: A test could have caught the broken CLI callers before the push. Without one, regressions in the code mapping stay unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for safeGit on a succeeding and a failing git command. Add tests for currentBranch and changedFiles too.
